# `"aql:string-util" import end  StringUtil.word args`. The broad string
# vocabulary (concat, split, trim, contains, …) lives in string.tsv; this
# §1  normalize — Unicode NFC by default; whitespace handling is opt-in

column3: default applies Unicode NFC (already-composed text is unchanged)
